title: Memory as a way out
sub: Minimize the energy. Each step goes to the best neighbour that isn't on the tabu list, even uphill.

frames.caption: Start at x = 168, the bottom of a valley. Hill climbing would stop right here. Tabu search keeps the last 10 positions on a forbidden list (red) and always moves to the best neighbour (up to 3 steps away) that isn't forbidden, even if it's worse.
Iteration 2: climbing, with its recent path forbidden behind it.
Iteration 4: every downhill neighbour is forbidden, so it takes the best allowed move: uphill. The memory is pushing it out of the valley.

Iteration 30: over the ridge and down into the deepest valley: a new best (green). It found what hill climbing from x = 168 never could.

Start at x = 168, the bottom of a valley. Hill climbing would stop right here. Tabu search keeps the last 3 positions on a forbidden list (red) and always moves to the best neighbour (up to 3 steps away) that isn't forbidden, even if it's worse.
Iteration 2: climbing, with its recent path forbidden behind it.
Iteration 4: every downhill neighbour is forbidden, so it takes the best allowed move: uphill. The memory is pushing it out of the valley.
Iteration 5: over the top of the ridge. Downhill moves are available again, into a valley it has never seen. The best (green) stays put until something better turns up.
Iteration 6: climbing, with its recent path forbidden behind it.
Iteration 8: this exact situation happened at iteration 3. With only 3 forbidden positions, the search is going round in a cycle and will never leave this valley.
